priority_items.title: LPMEL headline reaffirms Panguna commitment; still no BPS SITREP
priority_items.summary: Post Courier (15 Sep 18:07 PGT / 08:07 UTC) reports Lloyds Panguna Metals and Energy Limited condemned the Sunday arson and reaffirmed commitment to Bougainville. Body paywalled. Corroborates Toroama's earlier line that Lloyds management remained committed. RNZ still has no company reply. Maru/Tokura items and casualty CLAIMs unchanged.

priority_items.title: PMMM-4 sitting from 19:30 UTC; PNG Independence Day from 14:00 UTC
priority_items.summary: Tonga is already 16 Sep local (02:55 at cutoff). Official programme lists sitting 08:30–17:10 TOT; Matatoa/ministerial declaration adoption 15:30–17:00 TOT (02:30–04:00 UTC 16 Sep). No adopted text. PNG Independence Day local begins at this cutoff.

priority_items.title: MV Matui SAR toll band unchanged; PSC Day postponed
priority_items.summary: 2 confirmed dead, 14 survivors, ~30+ missing; 10 vessels still tasked east of Santo. VFSC strike-off remains a Daily Post CLAIM. PINA recap restates Napat UNGA cancel (already in the daily) and notes Public Service Commission Day in Torba is postponed.
